description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConvertBase' within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, specifically for engineering-related number base conversions. It includes methods for validating values and formatting number strings with leading zeros.

classes.name: ConvertBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods for converting and formatting numeric base values with validation.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates and converts the input value to a string, handling boolean and numeric types, and respecting the spreadsheet compatibility mode.

methods.name: validatePlaces
methods.description: Validates the number of places for formatting, ensuring it falls within acceptable bounds or throws an error.

methods.name: nbrConversionFormat
methods.description: Formats a string number by padding with leading zeros up to a specified length, with bounds check.
